entities.summary: Alexandra Joy Mollenhauer is a professional basketball player for Araski AES of the Primera FEB. Standing at 6 ft 0 in (1.83 m), she plays as a small forward. Born in the United States, she is a member of the Azerbaijan women's national 3x3 team. She is a three-time winner of the Islamic Solidarity Games.
